name: checkbox
description: A labelled box that toggles one option on or off, or shows a mixed state for a partial selection. Use for choices that take effect on submit; for a setting that applies immediately use a switch.

props.name: children
props.description: The label, shown next to the box and announced by screen readers.

props.name: isSelected
props.description: Controlled checked state; pair with onChange.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called with the new checked state.

props.name: isIndeterminate
props.description: Shows the mixed state, e.g. for a 'select all' whose items are partly selected.

props.name: isDisabled
props.description: Prevents changes and dims the checkbox.

props.name: isRequired
props.description: Requires the checkbox to be checked before the form submits.

props.name: isInvalid
props.description: Marks the value as invalid and draws the box in the danger color.

props.name: name
props.description: Form field name; the checkbox submits value when checked.

props.name: value
props.description: The value submitted with the form when checked.
